rows.Origin:
Bred by Werner Noack (Germany, 1997).
Introduced in Germany by Noack-Rosen in 1997 as 'Focus'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Whartons Nurseries Ltd. in 2007 as 'Focus'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-orange. None / no, opinions vary fragrance. Average diameter 3.5". Medium, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: up to 47" (up to 120cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
